## Why OpenAI requires `session.type`

When OpenAI promoted the Realtime API to GA, the `session` object was refactored into a typed resource. The GA schema treats the `session` payload as a polymorphic object and uses `"type": "realtime.session"` as a required discriminator field — the same pattern used for other OpenAI resource objects (e.g. `"object": "realtime.session"` in server responses). Without it, the API rejects the entire `session.update` event with **"Missing required parameter: session.type"** before any other session fields are processed.

The fix adds `"type": "realtime.session"` as the first field in `_buildSessionConfig()`, which is the single source of truth for the initial `session.update`. The type was also added to `RealtimeSessionResource` in `OpenAIRealtimeTypes.ts` so TypeScript enforces it going forward.
